title: Liberation of Skyrim
description: The overarching Stormcloak Civil War quest. Report to Ulfric Stormcloak in Windhelm for assignments, then speak to Galmar Stone-Fist at the relevant Stormcloak camp to receive specific battle missions. Liberate each Imperial-held hold by conquering its fort, culminating in the Battle for Solitude.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Stormcloak rebellion and Jarl of Eastmarch.
I direct the liberation campaign from the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.
I promote those who prove themselves in battle and grant titles and rewards.

LIBERATION_STARTED: This soldier has pledged to help liberate Skyrim from Imperial control.
LIBERATION_COMPLETED: We have won the war. Skyrim is free of Imperial rule.

base_facts: I am Ulfric's second-in-command and handle tactical field assignments.
I can be found in the main tent at Stormcloak camps, reviewing maps of the war.
Soldiers report to me with 'Reporting in' to receive their specific mission.

LIBERATION_STARTED: A new recruit has joined the liberation effort. I will assign them to the first hold.
LIBERATION_COMPLETED: The war is over. The Empire is driven from Skyrim.

beats.comment: Quest starts automatically after Battle for Whiterun. Player pledges to help liberate Skyrim.
Quest finishes after Battle for Solitude. General Tullius is dead and Skyrim is liberated.
